name: list_background_tasks
description: List background tasks. With scope="children" (default), lists all background child tasks that were started by this task using new_task with is_background=true. With scope="peers", lists all tasks sharing the same root task (siblings, aunts/uncles, grandchildren) — not just direct children. Returns each task's ID, title, current status, and creation timestamp.

scope.description: "children" (default): list only this task's direct background children. "peers": list all tasks sharing the same rootTaskId, excluding self.
